1.text: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."

2.text: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -

3.text: To worship Allāh, fear Him and obey me.

4.text: He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."

5.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.

6.text: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].

7.text: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments,<sup foot_note="228092">1</sup> persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.

9.text: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

10.text: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

11.text: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

12.text: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

13.text: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur

14.text: While He has created you in stages?<sup foot_note="228093">1</sup>

footnotes.228093: - i.e., in various progressive states and conditions.  See also 22:5 and 23:12-14 in reference to development of the embryo.

15.text: Do you not consider how Allāh has created seven heavens in layers<sup foot_note="228094">1</sup>

16.text: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

17.text: And Allāh has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.

18.text: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

19.text: And Allāh has made for you the earth an expanse

20.text: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"

21.text: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.

22.text: And they conspired an immense conspiracy

23.text: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'<sup foot_note="228095">1</sup>

footnotes.228095: - These were the names of specific idols named after pious men of earlier generations.

24.text: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."

25.text: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers.

26.text: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.

27.text: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.

28.text: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
